data.name: Re: promise - Promise of Linaria
data.detailed_description:
■ Story

You’ve lost your memory—everything except your own name.
When you wake up, you find yourself in Asugasaki City, a town surrounded by rumors of being haunted by ghosts.

Appearing before you are four men who claim to know your past:
A domineering childhood friend, a princely classmate, a laid-back underclassman, and a loyal butler who has sworn his devotion.

As you interact with each of them, fragments of your lost memory slowly begin to return.

Through the changing seasons, a bittersweet romance unfolds.
And what was the promise made between you and him…?

This is a story about regaining the memories—and the love—you once lost.

■ Character Introduction

Zero (Voice: Masahiro Yamanaka)
A confident and bossy young man who struggles with social interactions. A genius who excels at everything without even trying.
He seems to share a special connection with you…?

Kazu (Voice: Tomohisa Sako)
A cheerful and kind young man with prince-like charm. He’s usually gentle but occasionally says something sharp.
He’s always looking out for you, but the truth is…?

Shiki (Voice: Daisuke Motohashi)
A lethargic young man who lacks motivation for most things.
However, the art he creates as a hobby is known worldwide.
He seems to have a hidden goal…?

Ten (Voice: Ko Bonkobara)
Cool and serious on the outside, but passionate deep down.
A natural leader who brings the group together.
He calls you “My Lady,” but what does that really mean…?

■ How to Play / System

  • Launch the app and start reading the story

  • Choose the guy you're interested in

  • Your choices will affect his affection level and lead to different story branches!

  • As his affection increases, sweet love scenarios will be unlocked!

  • There are three different endings! The outcome depends on your choices!

  • As you progress, you'll unlock the "Chat" feature to talk with him!

■ Features (Key Highlights)

  • Multiple endings that change based on your choices

  • Fully voiced story by a cast of popular voice actors

  • Heart-pounding love scenarios with voice acting

  • A slightly serious tone for those who enjoy deeper narratives

  • Stills (CGs) and love stories that unlock based on your choices

■ Estimated Total Playtime

Approximately 18 hours

■ Supported Languages

Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese
Note: All voice lines are in Japanese regardless of language settings

Some parts of the story may contain sexual content that is not suitable for all ages.
